newsitem.title: CHINA: COSCO Pac, Liu Chong Hing shares still suspended.
newsitem.headline: COSCO Pac, Liu Chong Hing shares still suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of COSCO Pacific Ltd, Liu Chong Hing Bank Ltd and Liu Chong Hing Investment Ltd remained suspended on Monday pending an announcement.
Company officials were not available for comment.
Trading in Liu Chong Hing Bank shares was suspended on Thursday. Liu Chong Hing Investment and COSCO Pacific shares were suspended on Friday.
COSCO Pacific said on Friday it proposed to buy 89 million shares, or 20 percent of the enlarged share capital, of Liu Chong Hing Bank.

COSCO Pacific said it planned to buy 20 million Liu Chong Hing Bank shares from parent COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd, 24 million shares from an undisclosed shareholder of the bank and 45 million new shares to be issued by the bank.
The purchase price and other details were not immediately available.
